bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; authorizing placement of automated license plate readers in certain highway rights-of-way; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 160.27, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 160.27, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 15.+]

[+Automated license plate readers.+]

[+(a) For purposes of this subdivision, the following terms have the meanings given: +]

[+(1) "automated license plate reader" has the meaning given in section 13.824, subdivision 1; +]

[+(2) "highway authority" means the commissioner with respect to trunk highways, and a county with respect to county state-aid highways and county highways under its jurisdiction; and +]

[+(3) "law enforcement agency" has the meaning given in section 626.84, subdivision 1, paragraph (f). +]

[+(b) Notwithstanding section 160.2715, a local law enforcement agency may place and operate an automated license plate reader at a stationary location within the right-of-way of a trunk highway, county state-aid highway, or county highway if: +]

[+(1) the law enforcement agency provides notice to the highway authority that: +]

[+(i) is submitted at least 14 days prior to placement at, and immediately following removal from, each location; and +]

[+(ii) includes specific location information for each automated license plate reader; +]

[+(2) the automated license plate reader is affixed to an existing traffic sign, lighting device, or traffic-control device or is placed following guidance developed by the commissioner; +]

[+(3) the automated license plate reader is not located in a manner that constitutes a hazard of collision for motorists or impairs proper function of the highway; and +]

[+(4) the location is within the jurisdiction of the law enforcement agency. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; authorizing placement of automated license plate readers in certain highway rights-of-way; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 160.27, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 160.27, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 15.

Automated license plate readers.

(a) For purposes of this subdivision, the following terms have the meanings given:

(1) "automated license plate reader" has the meaning given in section 13.824, subdivision 1;

(2) "highway authority" means the commissioner with respect to trunk highways, and a county with respect to county state-aid highways and county highways under its jurisdiction; and

(3) "law enforcement agency" has the meaning given in section 626.84, subdivision 1, paragraph (f).

(b) Notwithstanding section 160.2715, a local law enforcement agency may place and operate an automated license plate reader at a stationary location within the right-of-way of a trunk highway, county state-aid highway, or county highway if:

(1) the law enforcement agency provides notice to the highway authority that:

(i) is submitted at least 14 days prior to placement at, and immediately following removal from, each location; and

(ii) includes specific location information for each automated license plate reader;

(2) the automated license plate reader is affixed to an existing traffic sign, lighting device, or traffic-control device or is placed following guidance developed by the commissioner;

(3) the automated license plate reader is not located in a manner that constitutes a hazard of collision for motorists or impairs proper function of the highway; and

(4) the location is within the jurisdiction of the law enforcement agency.
